title: All the Natural Notes
body: The white keys of the piano are called natural notes: A B C D E F G. They repeat in octaves. Once you know where all seven live on the staff, you can read any melody.

title: Two Full Octaves
caption: C to C covers one octave (8 notes). Here we travel two full octaves across both staves — watch how the notes climb steadily from C4 all the way up to D5.
